annotations.text: 375 — the stage loses the phone silhouette. She is already holding a phone; drawing one inside it is a picture of a picture. The thread plays directly on the field, and the three cards resolve beneath a hairline. CTA goes full width at 56px.

768 — the two hero columns stack. Copy keeps a 560px measure instead of running the full width, so the headline still breaks in three lines. The stage drops below it at full content width. Nav collapses to wordmark, Start a gift, and a two-rule menu.

1280 — same asymmetric 5 / 6 split as 1440, margins at 64, stage 520 tall. Nothing reflows here; it is the same layout at a tighter measure. If the two widths looked different, one of them would be wrong.

1440+ — 12 columns, 96px margins. Copy sits in columns 1–5, the stage in 7–12, so a whole empty column separates them. That gap is the most expensive thing on the page. Content caps at 1440 and centres beyond it; the ground colour runs edge to edge.

Copy is the brief's, verbatim, with three design decisions on top:

— "for her" is set in the serif's italic. It is the only italic in the hero, and it puts the emphasis on the person rather than the product.
— The moss eyebrow is the one place the second accent appears above the fold.
— "She did none of it." under the resolved cards. Four words carrying the whole proposition, in her voice, in the serif.

One primary action only. "Start a gift" stays a quiet text link in the nav so "See the gift" is unopposed.

Nine frames, 14.0 seconds, reading left to right in three rows. Each frame shows the state at the end of its beat, not the transition into it — the transition is written in the Motion row beneath.

The three columns inside every frame stay fixed: the photography plate, her thread, and the things around her. Nothing moves between columns. The whole piece is one idea — the right-hand column resolving while she does almost nothing.

This is the set the hero establishes, and it is meant to be the whole set. Ten colours, two families, one shadow, two radii, one stagger value.

Every later section — data forward, care balance, the package open state, the six flow steps — is built from exactly this and nothing added. If a section needs a new token, the section is wrong.
